source.note: Google publishes no reset feed, so this column is hand-curated. This note used to say Google has no recurring reset mechanism; that has been wrong since 2025-12-05. Google has forced Antigravity-wide usage resets on 2026-05-21 (twice), 2026-05-23, 2026-06-02 and 2026-07-21. Those five are absent from the rows below because no post id has been verified for them and this project does not publish an event it cannot link to; what is listed here is documented policy changes only.

events.text: Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers now get Gemini CLI and Gemini Code Assist with higher daily model request limits.

Gemini CLI and Gemini Code Assist IDE extensions stop serving requests for individuals / AI Pro / AI Ultra; free-tier access is replaced by Antigravity CLI at a much lower daily request ceiling (~20/day vs 1,000/day).
